nodes.label: PV Loop Escalation Model
nodes.rationale: PV-loop-only logistic regression trained on 6 features (Ees, Ea, Ees/Ea, ESP, EDP, Pmax) to isolate ventricular mechanics contribution to MCS escalation risk. AUC 0.6625 indicates moderate discriminative power.

nodes.label: RV Dysfunction Logistic Regression Model
nodes.rationale: Logistic Regression with 185 engineered features achieving AUC ~0.92. Exported as JSON coefficients to enable direct client-side integration in TypeScript/JavaScript without spawning Python at runtime.

nodes.label: Patient Cluster Profiles
nodes.rationale: Consensus K-Means (k=3, 200 bootstrap iterations) on 20 features producing three clinical phenotypes with survival, escalation, and renal failure rates per cluster.

nodes.label: Cardiometabolic (High-risk) Cluster
nodes.rationale: 35 patients with elevated pre-implant lactate, hepatic dysfunction, and poor hemodynamic response. Recommendation: consider advanced MCS, RV support, or transplant evaluation.

nodes.label: Cardiorenal (Moderate-risk) Cluster
nodes.rationale: 17 patients with elevated creatinine, congestion, and borderline hemodynamics. Recommendation: staged escalation planning with close monitoring for RV deterioration.

nodes.label: Non-congested (Low-risk) Cluster
nodes.rationale: 16 patients with best preserved renal function, lowest lactate, and positive CPO response. Recommendation: early weaning candidates.

nodes.label: Main Entry Point
nodes.rationale: React 19 application bootstrap using createRoot and StrictMode.

nodes.label: getRiskColor
nodes.rationale: Traditional bedside risk flag logic using post-implant RA pressure (>20 mmHg) and PAPI (<1.0) thresholds to color-code patient risk levels. Bridges classical hemodynamic criteria with ML risk scores in the dashboard.

nodes.label: ML Model Documentation
nodes.rationale: Clinical documentation for three ML models: survival (RandomForest, AUC 0.54, deemed not clinically useful), escalation (RandomForest, AUC 0.86), and RV dysfunction (Logistic Regression, AUC 0.92). Describes 172 engineered features, median imputation strategy, 5-fold stratified CV, and interpretation thresholds (<0.15 low, 0.15-0.30 moderate, >0.30 high).

nodes.label: Survival Prediction Model
nodes.rationale: RandomForest model predicting in-hospital mortality with AUC 0.54. Deemed not clinically useful because survival is driven by unmeasured factors such as refractory arrhythmia and multi-organ failure.

nodes.label: MCS Escalation Prediction Model
nodes.rationale: RandomForest model predicting need for ECMO, LVAD, transplant, or post-implant arrest with AUC 0.86. Key drivers: pre-implant hemodynamics, VIS score, inotrope burden, and SCAI stage.

nodes.label: RV Dysfunction Prediction Model
nodes.rationale: Logistic Regression model predicting composite RV failure criteria (post PAPI <1.0, RA >20, TAPSE <1.6, RV S' <9.5, RV-CPO drop >30%, or explicit RV failure note) with AUC 0.92.

nodes.label: Clinical User Guide
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive bedside HTML guide covering data sources (6 Excel sheets), full-stack architecture, feature engineering, model interpretation, dashboard metrics reference, recommended 4-step workflow, and risk-score thresholds with explicit cautionary language.

nodes.label: PV Loop Analysis Guide
nodes.rationale: Standalone HTML page with client-side rendering of PV loop regression coefficients, SHAP explainability top-5 features, Ees/Ea threshold zones, and per-patient SHAP breakdown table. Fetches data from /api/pv-loop-data and dynamically renders coefficient bar charts.

nodes.label: ML Model Report
nodes.rationale: Full cross-validation results comparing LogisticRegression and RandomForest per target. LR wins for RV dysfunction (AUC 0.925) and survival (AUC 0.537); RF wins for escalation (AUC 0.950). 185 engineered features documented.

nodes.label: Clustering Report
nodes.rationale: Consensus K-Means clustering report with silhouette score 0.105, 20 features, and clinical interpretation of three phenotypes. Acknowledges small sample size (67 patients) and missing data limitations.
